title: The hollow's live tooth measures a fixture repo built for the purpose, not a decayed historic ticket
intention: The hollow's many-file tooth measures a scratch fixture repo built for the purpose (several declared files, one checked per proof, one checked by nothing, the instrument itself declared), instead of a fixed historic ticket whose build later work has made unrevertable; every invariant the tooth asserts stays.
why: Measured 2026-10-30: cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py's live tooth raises HollowUnmeasurable from measure('9579a6f9cec6') at :433, because 9579's build commit 433cdc908813 no longer reverse-applies over cairn/tools/base/diagnostic.py after e8b58520aeb9 changed it (ce92eb562cf9's designed refusal). Four more tester proofs red only by running test_hollow.py whole. A fixed historic subject is a snapshot by another name, and it decays as later work edits its files. measure('c9897770efe6') measured cleanly that day in 118.9s with one worktree. Akien chose the subject 2026-11-01: CC offered (a) the newest qualifying PROVED ticket, (b) a pinned commit, (c) a small fixture repo built for the purpose, recommending (c) because it does not drift as the real repo changes; Akien: "agreed".
traces_to: Law 9 (a PROVED proof gone red is red until fixed); Law 3 (the instrument's refusal is correct, so the subject moves, not the instrument); the tooth's own rule: invariants, never the day's counts.
how: EXISTS cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py: the module-level PROVES dict (about :36) already holding the entry "1d23d635f7ca" with keys "1" and "2"; the live tooth test_the_live_run_reads_every_writes_to_file_it_did_not_skip_for_a_named_reason (at about :383), and the fixture helpers _fixture_spread(tmp) (a two-commit scratch repo: subject.py, second.py, unchecked.py, proofs/test_fixture.py, proofs/test_second.py, BUILDME and PROVEME crossings journaled), _berth_decompose(tmp, files), _berths_root(tmp), _git, FIXTURE. EXISTS cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py (measure, scratch_worktree). The live tooth measures the fixture (D1); a second tooth proves the subject is the fixture and reads the same twice (D2).
falsifier: Falsifier: Done when cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py runs green twice under bin/cairn test --exec, and for 1d23d635f7ca: (1) test_the_live_run_reads_every_writes_to_file_it_did_not_skip_for_a_named_reason is green over the fixture repo, every invariant it asserts unchanged (seen == declared, nothing both measured and skipped, something measured, every skip reason named, more than one declared file, ONE worktree, the hang guard, the reverted commit precedes buildme_at); (2) test_the_many_file_subject_is_a_fixture_that_reads_the_same_twice is green. The build touches only the proof, which is the instrument, so the hollow reading is a proofs-only build approved by its plan. Wrong intent if measure() cannot read a many-file fixture with one shared worktree (then measure() is broken, not its subject). proven_by = cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py.

decisions.step: the live tooth measures the fixture
decisions.text: In cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py, in test_the_live_run_reads_every_writes_to_file_it_did_not_skip_for_a_named_reason: build the subject with tmp = scratch_dir('cairn-hollowlive-'); repo, commons = _fixture_spread(tmp); then re-berth with declared_files = ['subject.py', 'second.py', 'unchecked.py', 'proofs/test_fixture.py'] via _berth_decompose(tmp, declared_files), so the instrument is declared and its skip reason is exercised. Replace measure('9579a6f9cec6', repo_root=_REPO_ROOT, timeout=120) with measure(FIXTURE, repo_root=repo, commons=commons, berths_root=_berths_root(tmp), timeout=60) inside the same worktree-counting wrapper. Drop the read of 9579's ticket and the imports of writes_to and _ticket_path; declared_files is the list berthed. The commit-precedes check reads _git(repo, ...) instead of _git(_REPO_ROOT, ...). Every other assert stays as written. Docstring: first line 'THE MANY-FILE FIRING, over a fixture repo built for it — invariants, never the day's counts.'; add a paragraph: on 2026-10-30 the fixed subject 9579a6f9cec6 became unmeasurable (433cdc908813 no longer reverse-applies over diagnostic.py after e8b58520aeb9); Akien chose a built fixture 2026-11-01 ('agreed') because it does not drift as the real repo changes; residue: the tooth no longer reads the live repo's history, so a live-only fault (a real hook, a real worktree under load) is outside it. Keep the remaining docstring paragraphs.

decisions.step: the second tooth and the key
decisions.text: Add 'def test_the_many_file_subject_is_a_fixture_that_reads_the_same_twice():' directly after the live tooth. It builds the same subject twice (two scratch dirs, _fixture_spread + the same re-berth), measures each, and asserts: both findings' commit resolves in its own fixture repo (git cat-file -e <commit> there returns 0) and is not an object of _REPO_ROOT (git -C _REPO_ROOT cat-file -e returns non-zero); (f['measured'], f['hollow'], [s['file'] for s in f['skipped']]) are equal across the two runs; f['hollow'] == ['unchecked.py']; returns True. In PROVES change "1d23d635f7ca" key "2" to 'test_the_many_file_subject_is_a_fixture_that_reads_the_same_twice'. Run: bin/cairn test --exec 'python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py', twice. Hollow: bin/cairn test --hollow 1d23d635f7ca --proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py (a proofs-only build).
PROVES is the module-level dict at the top of cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py (about :36); its "1d23d635f7ca" entry already exists with keys "1" and "2"; only key "2"'s value changes.

PROVED refused hollow_nothing_measured: the build's one file, cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py, is the hollow's own instrument and is skipped by rule. The ticket now carries a top-level writes_to naming it, so bin/cairn test --hollow 1d23d635f7ca --seal (2026-11-02) approves it by plan (bf1cd5d79805); BUILDME, PROVEME and PROVED are re-crossed naming only cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py, and a fresh verdict is written after the re-crossed BUILDME. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py is not in writes_to and this build does not open or change it: D2's tooth calls the names test_hollow.py already imports from it at :27 (measure among them), exactly as the live tooth beside it does, and D4's seal runs it only through the command bin/cairn test --hollow 1d23d635f7ca --seal. Nothing in hollow.py has to be read to build either step; approval() returning 'plan' when the ticket's top-level writes_to names every skipped file is its documented contract (bf1cd5d79805).
